::: {.lead}
Where the secrets live and where untrusted code runs, then each control with the test that proves it, and the gaps that are known.
:::

::: {.diagram-fit}
```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-trust
%%| fig-cap: "Trust boundaries. The secrets stay on the worker host. Repo code and model commands run in a sandbox with none."
flowchart LR
  ISSUES["GitHub issues<br/>read by the poller"]
  subgraph BOX["Sandbox: untrusted code"]
    SANDBOX["Docker container<br/>runs repo code<br/>no secrets, no capabilities<br/>network for setup only"]
  end
  MODEL["Model API"]
  subgraph HOST["Worker host: trusted"]
    WORKER["Worker<br/>holds the GitHub token<br/>and the model API keys"]
    WRITES["github/side_effects.py<br/>every write carries<br/>an idempotency key"]
    PUSH["Branch guard and push<br/>never a default branch"]
  end
  GITHUB["GitHub repo<br/>branch, comments, PR"]
  PERSON(["A person reviews<br/>and merges"])
  ISSUES -->|issue text, untrusted| WORKER
  WORKER --> WRITES
  WORKER --> PUSH
  WORKER --> SANDBOX
  WORKER --> MODEL
  WRITES -->|comments, labels, PR| GITHUB
  PUSH -->|task branch| GITHUB
  GITHUB --> PERSON
```
:::
